title: fix(i18n): every count plural family carries every CLDR plural category its locale selects (objectui#11432)
body:
Fixes #11432

Clause-②: no

## What changed

Every i18next count plural family now carries, in every locale pack, one slot per CLDR category that pack's language selects: the set `Intl.PluralRules(lang).resolvedOptions().pluralCategories` reports (measured on Node 22.22.0, ICU 77.1, CLDR 47). A base key standing in for a category no longer counts. The new pin computes the expected slots from `Intl.PluralRules`. It is not a hand-kept list.

### Enumeration (measured at `175df47ef`)

- **Family rule.** Any leaf whose name ends in `_zero`, `_one`, `_two`, `_few`, `_many` or `_other` makes its stem a family. This is how i18next itself reads a pack, and it is the rule the existing base-key test already used. No call site is needed. Families are the union over `en` and each pack.
- **Population.** 14 families, the same in all 10 packs: `calendar.a11y.dayCell`, `chatbot.plan.countDashboards` / `countObjects` / `countViews`, `console.ai.usage.resetsWeeklyDays` / `resetsWeeklyHours`, `console.settingsView.unsavedCount`, `detail.fileCount` / `repeaterItemCount` / `showEmptyRelated`, and `perm.facet.fields` / `objects` / `rls` / `tabs`.
- **Categories per pack.** en, de: one, other. zh, ja, ko: other. fr, es, pt: one, many, other. ru: one, few, many, other. ar: zero, one, two, few, many, other.
- **Missing before: 196 slots.**
  - 70 `_other`: 7 families held only `_one` plus a base key, in all 10 packs.
  - 70 `_many`: fr, es, pt, ru, ar.
  - 28 `_few`: ru, ar.
  - 14 `_two` and 14 `_zero`: ar.
  - Per pack: en, zh, ja, ko, de 7 each; fr, es, pt 21 each; ru 35; ar 63.
- **Missing after: 0 in every pack.** This is the new pin's reading.

### The forms

- **`_other` for the 7 families.** In en, zh, ja, ko, de, fr, es and pt the base already is the `other` form, so its value is reused. ru uses the genitive singular (fractions). ar uses the singular (100-102 and so on).
- **ru.** `_few` (2-4, 22-24) is the genitive singular. `_many` (0, 5-20) is the genitive plural.
- **ar.**
  - `_zero`: singular.
  - `_two`: the dual with the numeral in parentheses, for example `ملفان (2)`.
  - `_few` (3-10): plural.
  - `_many` (11-99): accusative singular, for example `ملفًا`.
- **fr, es, pt `_many` (exact millions).** "de" goes before the noun: `1000000 de fichiers`, `d'heures`, `de archivos`, `de arquivos`. `detail.showEmptyRelated` keeps the `_other` words, because there the count governs no noun complement.

### Existing slots corrected (16; same families, same defect class)

- **ar `_other` (100-102…), 6 families.** These held the 3-10 plural and now hold the singular: `resetsWeeklyDays`, `resetsWeeklyHours`, `unsavedCount`, `fileCount`, `repeaterItemCount`, `showEmptyRelated`. This was reachable: 100 files read `100 ملفات`.
- **ru `_other` (fractions), the same 6.** These held the genitive plural and now hold the genitive singular. No integer count reaches this slot. It is corrected so every slot holds the form of its own category.
- **ru `perm.facet.*` `_one`, 4 keys.** Changed from the `Объектов: N` label to `N объект`, so the facet badge reads the same way at 1, 3 and 5.

### Before and after (plain i18next 26.4.0 over the shipped packs)

| lookup | before, `175df47ef` | after |
|---|---|---|
| ru `resetsWeeklyHours` 2 / 3 / 22 | Сброс через 2 / 3 / 22 часов | Сброс через 2 / 3 / 22 часа |
| ru `resetsWeeklyHours` 1 / 21 / 5 | час / час / часов | час / час / часов (unchanged) |
| ar `resetsWeeklyHours` 2 | 2 ساعة(ساعات) حتى إعادة التعيين | ساعتان (2) حتى إعادة التعيين |
| ar `resetsWeeklyHours` 11 | 11 ساعة(ساعات) حتى إعادة التعيين | 11 ساعة حتى إعادة التعيين |
| ar `resetsWeeklyHours` 100 | 100 ساعات حتى إعادة التعيين | 100 ساعة حتى إعادة التعيين |
| fr `detail.fileCount` 1000000 | 1000000 fichiers | 1000000 de fichiers |

English, and the de, zh, ja and ko strings a user sees, do not change. The only new en keys are the 7 `_other` slots, and they repeat the base.

## The pins

- **`all-locales-key-parity.test.ts`, new third section.** For every pack and every family, each category slot must be a real, non-empty leaf, and the expected set is computed. The rule "no pack defines a key en lacks" now has exactly one computed exception, `isLocalPluralSlot`: the slot of an `en` family for a category the pack's own language selects. So a `de` `_many` or a `ru` `_two` is still refused, and a test pins that. Two more checks: slots that only a pack holds must carry the family's `en` placeholders, and an ordinal-suffix tripwire fires the first time an `_ordinal_` key appears. The header now records the rule and where its reach ends.
- **`plural-categories-11432.test.ts`, new.** A real `i18next.createInstance()` over the shipped packs. For every pack, family and category, it takes a sample count from `Intl.PluralRules` (integers 0-200, then 1000000, then 1.5) and asserts via `returnDetails` that the key which answered is exactly that category's slot, in that pack. A base key or an English fallback standing in therefore fails, even where the words happen to match. It also holds triage's pins: ru `resetsWeeklyHours` at 1, 3, 5 and 21 reads `час`, `часа`, `часов`, `час`.
- **Earlier pins my change made false, updated.**
  - `perm-home-namespace-3546.test.tsx` and `showEmptyRelated-plural-base-3863.test.tsx` now compute the answering slot from the pack and pin the new ru and ar forms.
  - `cellRenderers.countLabelI18n-8441.test.tsx` (`@object-ui/fields`) expects ru `_few` at 2 and `_many` at 0.
  - In `searchItemsAvailable-plural-9664.test.ts` and `SettingsView.i18n-4024.test.tsx` (console) the assertions are unchanged. Only prose this change made false was corrected.
  - The pack comments next to the families are updated the same way. The ru and ar perm-block notes are rewritten in English.

### Ablation (run at `7e18d1f6b`, implementation committed; through `ablation-replace.mjs` with an anchor that must hit and a trap restore)

- **Mutation.** Deleted ru `resetsWeeklyHours_few` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `4f957998513d` → `d7d061a9e7d7`) and ar `fileCount_two` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `b6406916953e` → `135c31ec7f00`).
- **Result.** `Tests 5 failed | 52 passed (57)`:
  - parity names `console.ai.usage.resetsWeeklyHours_few` (ru) and `detail.fileCount_two` (ar);
  - the i18next pin reports `resetsWeeklyHours_few @ 2: answered by ru:console.ai.usage.resetsWeeklyHours` and `detail.fileCount_two @ 2: answered by ar:detail.fileCount`;
  - the triage pin received `Сброс через 3 часов`.
- **Restore.** For both files, the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Code-selected count labels (outside the family rule, not changed here)

Two count labels are chosen in code, not by i18next. In both, the count-not-one half holds one noun form:

- `detail.attachmentCount` / `attachmentCountPlural`, chosen in `packages/plugin-detail/src/CommentAttachment.tsx` on `attachments.length !== 1`.
- `detail.replyCount` / `replyCountPlural`, chosen in `packages/plugin-detail/src/ThreadedReplies.tsx` on `replies.length === 1`.

Measured over the packs: ru gives `3 вложений`, `21 ответов`; ar gives `2 مرفقات`, `11 ردود`, `100 مرفقات`. The selection site is outside `packages/i18n`, so these are in the report for a seat to file, not fixed here.

## Gates (final HEAD `7e18d1f6b`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over `packages/i18n/` plus every test that names one of the 14 families or a changed ru/ar string (91 files): `Test Files 91 passed (91)`, `Tests 1794 passed | 13 skipped (1807)`.
- `pnpm --filter "@object-ui/i18n^..." build && pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`: exit 0. The `type-check` script echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. `--listFiles` counts all 5 changed i18n test files in the program.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`: exit 0, "Every in-scope call-site key resolves against the en pack (3144 keys)…".
- `pnpm check:i18n-drift`: "0 en value(s) changed (7 key(s) added…)".
- `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only): none of the new keys is listed.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: "0 new citation(s)".
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: declares `.changeset/11432-plural-categories-every-pack.md`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: OK.
- eslint over the 17 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 17 files, 0 errors, 16 warnings. All 16 are pre-existing `no-explicit-any` in the fields 8441 test; the base blob shows the same 16.
  - This narrowed run is a measurement because: every file resolves a config via `--print-config`, so it is in the linted population; the count comes from eslint's own JSON; and `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting and no local rule reads other files, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **NOT MEASURED, left to CI.**
  - `type-check` of `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/console`. Their only edits are test strings and comments on `any`-typed reads.
  - The eager-closure and eager-locale-catalogue budgets. Both need a full console build. The resident en catalogue grows by 7 short keys.
- **Forms worth a native reader's eye.**
  - ar `_two` uses the dual plus the numeral in parentheses, the convention Android's Arabic plural strings use.
  - ar `detail.showEmptyRelated`: an adjective standing for an omitted masculine noun. Its forms are derived from the agreement rules, and this is the least certain family.
  - The 42 fr, es and pt `_many` forms are reachable only at exact millions.
- **Prose this PR makes historical but does not touch** (outside the 14 families; nobody else is set to edit these files):
  - en `fields.textarea` (`charactersRemaining` note) and the commit-timeline `items` note, both of which say "do not upgrade to a family, parity leaves ru without `_few`";
  - the header of `countLabels.ruAr-10242.test.tsx` in `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- **Non-family count keys.** A ru census found count keys outside any family that agree one noun form with the number, for example `approvalsInbox.bulkApproveTitle` gives `Согласовать 3 запросов?` and `grid.import.importNRows` gives `Импортировать 3 строк`. They are outside this card's family rule and are reported, not changed.
